biotools.summary: The PRIMA Panel is an R Shiny tool designed to assess the impact of preanalytical variations on metabolomics samples and predict metabolite stability. It was developed and validated based on findings from a study on the effects of centrifugation and freezing delays on metabolite concentrations, and is suitable for use within biobanks.
